pdsp_references.reference: Pauwels PJ, Van Gompel P, and Leysen JE, 1993
Pauwels PJ, Van Gompel P, and Leysen JE, 1993

provenance.aggregation_rule: Per drug x target: ChEMBL activities with standard_type=Ki, target_organism=Homo sapiens, target a ChEMBL SINGLE PROTEIN resolved from the panel's UniProt accession, standard_relation='=', standard_units='nM', pchembl_value present, no data_validity_comment, not potential_duplicate. pChEMBL values are grouped by document_chembl_id, averaged within each document, and pki_median is the median of those per-document means. ki_nM = 10**(9-pki_median). ki_min_nM/ki_max_nM are the extremes of the individual measurements. GtoPdb and PDSP measurements join this pool under merge_rule.
provenance.censored_handling: ChEMBL Ki rows with standard_relation '>' or '>=' (same human / panel-target / nM / validity filters) and PDSP rows with ki Note '>' (PDSP row filter; PMID-duplicates of a ChEMBL censored document dropped) are summarised per gene under each drug's ki_lower_bounds: ki_lower_bound_nM = smallest censored threshold, ki_lower_bound_max_nM = largest; ChEMBL documents under documents, PDSP publications under pdsp_references. They are never merged into targets/ki_nM/pki_median and do not remove a gene from searched_and_empty. '<', '<=' and '~' rows are not used.

gtopdb.ligand_mapping: GtoPdb ligand -> v2 drug only when the ligand's ChEMBL ID equals the drug's ChEMBL parent id or its InChIKey equals the ChEMBL parent's full standard InChIKey; no name matching. Ligands matching >1 drug dropped.
gtopdb.row_filter: Target Species=Human; single Target UniProt ID equal to the panel accession; Affinity Units=pKi; Original Affinity Relation '=' or blank; Affinity Median numeric.

provenance.held_out_note: Binding is a model input, not a held-out outcome (pipeline/guards.py V2_TRUTH / v2_heldout); no held-out membership is recorded in this file.
provenance.kd_handling: Kd rows (same filters, standard_type=Kd) are kept separate under kd_only for drug x target pairs with no qualifying Ki, and are never merged into the Ki aggregate.
provenance.merge_rule: All '=' Ki measurements from ChEMBL, GtoPdb and PDSP are pooled per drug x gene. ChEMBL rows are grouped by document_chembl_id, GtoPdb rows by PubMed id (or per row when no PMID), PDSP rows by PMID (PubMed Link) or 'PDSP:<Reference>'. A GtoPdb or PDSP group whose PMID an earlier source (order ChEMBL, GtoPdb, PDSP) already has for the same pair is dropped as a duplicate of the same publication. pki_median = median of per-publication mean pKi; ki_nM = 10**(9-pki_median). No source is preferred.
provenance.no_data_handling: A drug x target pair with zero qualifying Ki rows is listed by gene in that drug's searched_and_empty array; it is never imputed or omitted silently.

pdsp.ligand_mapping: PDSP SMILES -> RDKit largest fragment, uncharged -> standard InChIKey, equal to the ChEMBL parent's full standard InChIKey; no name matching. InChIKeys shared by >1 v2 drug dropped.
pdsp.row_filter: species == 'HUMAN' exactly; Unigene equal to a panel gene resolved on the ChEMBL side; ki Val numeric, 1e-3..1e6 nM; ki Note blank = measured, '>' = lower bound, '<' unused; PMID only from a PubMed Link.
pdsp.tls: fetched with an unverified TLS context (server CA chain not verifiable)
